description: Search the U.S. Federal Register (federalregister.gov) for rules, proposed rules, notices, presidential documents and executive orders by keyword, agency (name, short name such as EPA, or slug), type, publication date range and significance. Returns document number, title, type, agencies, action, abstract, citation, effective and comment-close dates, EO number and signing date, docket ids, RINs and HTML/PDF links. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/federal-register

agency.description: Agency name, short name or slug (comma list up to 5)

type.description: Comma list: rule, proposed_rule, notice, presidential_document, executive_order

name: federal_register
title: Federal Register
